$Comment: Scope-2 wave-3 leg W3-F (design section 2.7, GATE OUTCOMES m1 fix, decision 40): the flagship multi-station fish exemplar, attached to Server/RpgStations/Stations/CuttingBoard.json via {"Ref":"prepfish"}. Custody.Input is authored explicitly (ResourceTypeId 'Fish', the native family every caught-fish item shares via Template_Fish_Item.json) because this action has no Recipe.Conversions for the usual zero-extra-authoring fallback to derive from - it is a Steps program. M1 FIX (critique-adopted, gate Q3/Q23): the old design draft split fish-scaling into a single step that BOTH consumed the raw fish AND repeated 3x - a Consume inside a Repeat re-executes the consume every iteration, over-draining custody. Fixed here by splitting 'load' (a one-shot Consume, Repeat absent) from 'scale' (a pure Duration BEAT with no Consume phase, Repeat:{Times:3}) - the authoring guide's own footgun callout. Tool gate = the DAGGERS weapon family (gate decision 40, Q12 OVERRIDDEN from the design draft's sickle placeholder): the real vanilla item family is 'Weapon_Daggers_*' (plural - hytale-shared-source/HytaleAssets/Server/Item/Items/Weapon/Daggers/*.json), enumerated here as concrete Ids per this leg's brief (the vanilla items also carry Tags.Family:['Dagger'] via their shared Template_Weapon_Daggers.json parent, a Tags.Family route was available but Ids was the directed choice, mirroring the Anvil's own explicit-Ids convention). Anchors.fire targets the 'cookingfire' station (Server/RpgStations/Stations/CookingFire.json) within a 12-block radius (the design-2.2 default MaxRadius). Work.Repeat:true + the engine's new StopReason.INPUTS_EXHAUSTED (design 2.4) is 'repeats while fish remain' with zero mode flags - the session ends gracefully once no more Fish custody remains at the next 'load' step's Consume. Sound/particle ids are all REAL, already-shipped-elsewhere ids (verified against the shared source / this repo's own usage), never invented placeholders: SFX_Daggers_T1_Swing (the vanilla dagger's own primary-swing sound, Weapon_Daggers_Crude.json), Smoke_Black (Deco_Campfire_Off.json's own particle), SFX_Player_Drop_Item (the vanilla generic item-place sound).
